chill.title: Spend an evening on the Isola Tiberina
chill.description: Sit on the stone banks of the boat-shaped island in the middle of the Tiber with the river running either side.
chill.bonus: Walk down to the water level rather than staying on the bridge.

chill.title: Watch the sun drop from the Pincio terrace
chill.description: Take the balustrade above Piazza del Popolo as the rooftops and domes turn copper.
chill.bonus: Get there thirty minutes before sunset and just wait.

chill.title: Wander the art nouveau streets of Quartiere Coppedè
chill.description: Find the four-block fairytale district of spiders, turrets and chandeliers that most Romans have never visited.
chill.bonus: Find the giant iron spider without looking it up first.

chill.title: Look through the Aventine keyhole at St Peter's
chill.description: Put your eye to a green door on a quiet piazza and find the dome framed perfectly at the end of a hedge tunnel.
chill.bonus: Go early enough that there's no queue at the door.

chill.title: Soak an afternoon away at QC Termeroma
chill.description: Work through thermal pools, steam rooms and a sauna circuit at a spa built on a Roman thermal site.
chill.bonus: Do the full cold plunge after every sauna round.

chill.title: Take a slow hour in the Trastevere botanical garden
chill.description: Climb the terraced garden behind Palazzo Corsini past bamboo, a Japanese garden and a fountain nobody else has found.
chill.bonus: Sit in the bamboo grove until you lose track of time.

chill.title: Wander the quiet paths of the Non-Catholic Cemetery
chill.description: Sit among cypress trees and the graves of Keats and Shelley in one of Rome's most peaceful, least-visited corners.
chill.bonus: Find Keats' grave and read the epitaph he wrote himself

chill.title: Spend a slow morning inside the Galleria Borghese
chill.description: Book the timed-entry slot and take one room at a time with Bernini's sculptures and Caravaggio's paintings almost to yourself.
chill.bonus: Pick one sculpture and just sit with it for five full minutes

chill.title: Watch the sunset from the Orange Garden on Aventine Hill
chill.description: Find a spot along the terrace wall at Giardino degli Aranci as the whole city turns gold below St Peter's dome.
chill.bonus: Stay until the streetlights come on

chill.title: Read a chapter on a bench in Villa Borghese
chill.description: Find shade under the pines near the Pincio terrace and let a slow afternoon in Rome's grandest park do the rest.
chill.bonus: Leave your phone in your bag the whole time

foodie.title: Eat a supplì standing up at Supplizio
foodie.description: Bite into a fried rice ball with a molten mozzarella core at the shop that made the Roman street snack respectable.
foodie.bonus: Order the one on the board you can't translate.

foodie.title: Shop the stalls of Mercato Trionfale
foodie.description: Walk 270 stalls of fish, cheese, porchetta and vegetables in the biggest covered market in the city, where actual Romans shop.
foodie.bonus: Buy lunch entirely from three different stalls.

foodie.title: Order cacio e pepe at Da Enzo al 29
foodie.description: Squeeze into a tiny Trastevere trattoria for the four-ingredient pasta Rome argues about most.
foodie.bonus: Go at opening time and queue rather than book elsewhere.

foodie.title: Drink natural wine at Litro in Monteverde
foodie.description: Take a table at the bar that brought low-intervention wine to Rome and let them pour you something cloudy.
foodie.bonus: Ask for the strangest bottle open tonight.

foodie.title: Book the tasting menu at Pipero Roma
foodie.description: Sit down for a long, sharp, modern take on Roman cooking in a small dining room near the Chiesa Nuova.
foodie.bonus: Take the wine pairing instead of choosing yourself.

foodie.title: Drink the gran caffè at Sant'Eustachio
foodie.description: Take the famously sweetened espresso at the counter of a 1938 bar that still won't tell anyone how it's made.
foodie.bonus: Drink it standing at the bar like a local, not sitting.

foodie.title: Eat a trapizzino on the street in Testaccio
foodie.description: Get a triangle of pizza dough stuffed with slow-cooked Roman offal or chicken cacciatora and eat it walking.
foodie.bonus: Pick the filling you'd normally avoid.

foodie.title: Order pizza al taglio by weight at Bonci Pizzarium
foodie.description: Point at rectangles of pizza behind the glass near the Vatican walls and eat them standing on the pavement.
foodie.bonus: Order four different slices and rank them.

foodie.title: Street-food crawl through Mercato Testaccio
foodie.description: Graze your way past trapizzino, supplì, and fifth-quarter classics at Rome's best-loved covered food market.
foodie.bonus: Order one thing you can't translate on the menu

foodie.title: Book the tasting menu at Roscioli Salumeria con Cucina
foodie.description: Work through a multi-course parade of Roman classics and rare Italian wines at one of the city's most obsessed-over restaurants.
foodie.bonus: Let the sommelier choose your wine pairing blind

foodie.title: Taste a gelato flight at Gelateria dei Gracchi
foodie.description: Line up four small scoops — pistachio, stracciatella, and two flavors you've never tried — at one of Rome's best artisanal gelaterias.
foodie.bonus: Pick your last flavor with your eyes closed

foodie.title: Learn to make carbonara from scratch in Trastevere
foodie.description: Roll up your sleeves in a hands-on class and walk out able to cook Rome's most argued-about pasta correctly.
foodie.bonus: Ask your instructor their most controversial carbonara opinion

culture.title: See Roman marbles among the turbines at Centrale Montemartini
culture.description: Find classical statues displayed against the boilers and generators of a decommissioned power station.
culture.bonus: Pick the single best statue-and-machine pairing in the building.

culture.title: Stand under the Sistine ceiling in the Vatican Museums
culture.description: Walk four kilometres of corridors packed with tapestries and maps to arrive, finally, under Michelangelo's ceiling.
culture.bonus: Book the earliest entry slot and beat the crowd to the chapel.

culture.title: Walk out onto the Colosseum's arena floor
culture.description: Pay for the arena-floor ticket and stand where the sand was, looking up at fifty thousand empty seats.
culture.bonus: Stay quiet for one full minute in the middle of the floor.

culture.title: Stand under the Pantheon's open oculus
culture.description: Step into a 1,900-year-old concrete dome with a hole in the top and watch the light column move across the floor.
culture.bonus: Go on a rainy day and watch the water fall through.

culture.title: Take a box at the Teatro dell'Opera di Roma
culture.description: Dress up for a gilded 1880 opera house where Puccini and Verdi both premiered work.
culture.bonus: Go in knowing nothing about the plot.

culture.title: Follow Zaha Hadid's concrete curves through MAXXI
culture.description: Trace poured-concrete ramps and black staircases through Rome's museum of 21st-century art and architecture.
culture.bonus: Spend as long looking at the building as at the art.

culture.title: Take a Serie A night at the Stadio Olimpico
culture.description: Sit in the Curva for Roma or Lazio and watch a full stadium run flags, flares and ninety minutes of noise.
culture.bonus: Learn the club anthem before you go in.

culture.title: Find three Caravaggios in San Luigi dei Francesi
culture.description: Drop a coin in the light box of a working church and watch the Contarelli Chapel flare into view for free.
culture.bonus: Stay for a second coin's worth.

adventure.title: Trek the Caffarella Valley past sheep and ruins
adventure.description: Walk a working farmed valley inside the city limits, where shepherds still graze flocks between Roman tombs.
adventure.bonus: Walk until you can't hear a single car.

adventure.title: Hike the crater rim above Lake Albano
adventure.description: Take the train into the Castelli Romani and walk the volcanic ridge above the lake, finishing with wine in a hill town.
adventure.bonus: Swim in the lake before you climb back up.

adventure.title: Take the glass lift to the Vittoriano roof terrace
adventure.description: Ride up the side of the giant white monument for the only view of Rome that includes the Colosseum and the Forum together.
adventure.bonus: Name five landmarks from the terrace without looking them up.

adventure.title: Walk the aqueduct arches at Parco degli Acquedotti
adventure.description: Cross a field of standing Roman aqueducts on the edge of the city as the light goes low and gold.
adventure.bonus: Walk under an arch and look straight up.

adventure.title: Hike the wooded ridge of Monte Mario
adventure.description: Climb the highest hill in Rome through holm oak woods to a terrace looking straight down on St Peter's dome.
adventure.bonus: Get to the viewpoint without checking your phone map.

adventure.title: Run the long loop through Villa Doria Pamphili
adventure.description: Take the biggest park in Rome at a jog, past umbrella pines, a formal garden and almost no tourists.
adventure.bonus: Run the full outer perimeter, not the short loop.

adventure.title: Ride a Vespa up to the Gianicolo terrace
adventure.description: Rent a scooter and wind up the Janiculum for the widest view in Rome and the cannon that fires at noon.
adventure.bonus: Be up there at midday for the cannon.

adventure.title: Spend a day in the ruined streets of Ostia Antica
adventure.description: Take the train to Rome's abandoned port city and walk paved streets, bath mosaics and a theatre with almost nobody around.
adventure.bonus: Sit in the theatre's top row for ten minutes.

adventure.title: Descend three eras beneath the Basilica di San Clemente
adventure.description: Walk down through a 12th-century church, a 4th-century basilica, and a 1st-century Mithraic temple, stacked on top of each other.
adventure.bonus: Find the underground stream still flowing at the lowest level

adventure.title: Explore the frescoed tunnels of the Catacombs of Priscilla
adventure.description: Follow a guide through miles of underground galleries holding some of the earliest known images of the Virgin Mary.
adventure.bonus: Spot the fresco of the Good Shepherd before your guide points it out

adventure.title: Run a sunrise loop around the Circus Maximus
adventure.description: Get your morning miles in on the same ground where chariots once raced, with the Palatine Hill glowing above you.
adventure.bonus: Count how many laps the ancient track would have needed for a full chariot race

adventure.title: Climb all 551 steps to the top of St Peter's Dome
adventure.description: Spiral up through the narrowing dome of the world's largest church to a 360° view over Rome and the Vatican Gardens.
adventure.bonus: Skip the elevator — walk every step from the base

adventure.title: Cycle the cobblestones of Via Appia Antica
adventure.description: Rent a bike and ride past 2,000-year-old tombs, aqueducts, and umbrella pines on Rome's oldest road.
adventure.bonus: Stop and touch one of the original Roman paving stones

adventure.title: Descend into the Capuchin Crypt's bone-lined chapels
adventure.description: Wander five eerily beautiful chapels beneath Santa Maria della Concezione, where the bones of 3,700 friars form the décor.
adventure.bonus: Guess how many friars are memorialized before reading the plaque

social.title: Walk the summer bars of Lungo il Tevere
social.description: Follow the pop-up bars, food stalls and dance floors that line the Tiber banks every night through the Roman summer.
social.bonus: Walk the whole stretch before you buy your first drink.

social.title: Find the door at The Jerry Thomas Project
social.description: Track down Rome's original speakeasy, get past the password and drink cocktails made like it's 1920.
social.bonus: Let the bartender make you something off-menu.

social.title: Drink craft beer at Ma Che Siete Venuti a Fà
social.description: Squeeze into a Trastevere room the size of a hallway, named after a football chant, with fifteen taps on the wall.
social.bonus: Drink something Italian you've never heard of.

social.title: Crawl the aperitivo bars of Pigneto
social.description: Work the pedestrian strip in Rome's scruffiest, most interesting neighbourhood, where a drink still buys you dinner.
social.bonus: Eat only what comes free with the drinks.

social.title: Dance until sunrise at Goa Club
social.description: Commit to Rome's long-running Ostiense techno institution and come out into the light at the end of it.

social.title: Order a negroni at Freni e Frizioni
social.description: Take a drink out to the terrace above the river in Trastevere, in a bar that was a mechanic's garage until it wasn't.
social.bonus: Take the drink outside rather than staying at the bar.

social.title: Catch a late set at Alexanderplatz jazz club
social.description: Take a table in Rome's oldest jazz club, a basement near the Vatican where the walls are covered in signatures.

social.title: Spend a night in the bars of San Lorenzo
social.description: Drink cheap in the student quarter behind Termini, where the walls are painted and nothing is polished.
social.bonus: Let a local pick the second bar.

social.title: Play pub trivia at an English-speaking bar in Trastevere
social.description: Team up with strangers and expats for a loud, competitive trivia night at one of Trastevere's expat-favorite pubs.
social.bonus: Join a table you don't already know

social.title: Join the aperitivo hour on a Monti rooftop bar
social.description: Grab a spritz and a plate of small bites as the golden hour crowd fills up a terrace above Rome's coolest neighborhood.
social.bonus: Strike up a conversation with whoever's next to you at the bar

social.title: Haggle your way through Porta Portese Sunday market
social.description: Dig through blocks of vintage clothes, records, and odd antiques alongside half of Trastevere at Rome's biggest flea market.
social.bonus: Negotiate the price on at least one item

social.title: Watch AS Roma play with the regulars at a Testaccio bar
social.description: Squeeze into a packed neighborhood bar near the old stadium grounds and feel the whole room rise on every shot on goal.

8ball.title: Throw a coin in the Trevi Fountain before 7am
8ball.description: Get to the most crowded monument in Rome before anyone else does and have the whole thing roaring away to yourself.
8ball.bonus: Throw it properly — right hand, over the left shoulder, back turned.

8ball.title: Put your hand in the Mouth of Truth
8ball.description: Queue at the portico of Santa Maria in Cosmedin and stick your hand into the marble mouth that supposedly bites liars.
8ball.bonus: Say something true out loud while your hand is in there.
